verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs claim it can 'automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically' (drata-docs-4). It also has a SafeBase-branded trust center for security reviews (drata-docs-24, drata-docs-10), so questionnaire automation exists in some form. Nothing in the pack shows AI drafting answers from your own controls or knowledge base, or a draft-then-review workflow. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated answers, answers grounded in actual controls or a knowledge base, a human review/approval step for drafts, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
